data.one_liner: A library for generating and analyzing graphs with JSON and ASCIIArtTree support.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to build, analyze, and scan paths through graph structures in Dart. It supports finding shortest paths, exporting graphs to JSON trees, and rendering ASCII art trees.
use_when: You need to build and manipulate graph data structures in memory.
You want to analyze paths, find shortest paths, or scan graph nodes.
You need to visualize graphs as JSON trees or ASCII art representations.
avoid_when: You need complex UI graph visualization components or interactive diagrams.
Your primary need is for standard statistical charting like bar, line, or pie charts.
strengths: Supports path finding and graph analysis algorithms.
Includes built-in support for generating ASCII art trees and JSON representations.
weaknesses: Does not provide interactive UI widgets for rendering graphs visually on screen.

alternatives.name: graphs
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick graphs if you want a dedicated package for graph algorithms and searching without extra ASCII/JSON tree formatting utilities.

alternatives.name: directed_graph
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick directed_graph if you specifically need to work with directed graphs.
